messages:
sam: Quick heads up 00hrs - bringing my tiny arcade cabinet for Saturday's LAN. Its 2-player, HDMI in, needs 5V USB power. Anyone got a spare 5V 2A adapter?

leo: I have a 5V 2.5A USB brick, can bring it. Also I can lug a folding table.

ida: Bringing a bag of controllers: 1 wired GC pad, 1 8-bitdo, 1 extra Pro Controller. Label as you like.

rachel: Tiny trade: I have an extra Steam key for Into the Breach if anyone wants it. First person to bring a themed dessert gets dibs. :eyes: 

sam: Adding a sticker system so controllers don't walk off. Well use masking tape + initials.

leo: Meme-bot, drop a sticker reminder in 10m? :harold:

meme-bot: Reminder: "LABEL YOUR JOYSTICKS" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

ida: Also FYI: the cabinet has a lossy audio jack. Bring speakers or a 3.5mm->RCA if you want louder sound.

rachel: Ill bring popovers (mini pastries) and a tiny sign that says "Do not feed the cabinet".

ops-bot: Facilities: Mezzanine C reserved 6:30PM-11:59PM. No open flames. Recycling bin on site.

sam: Plan: setup 6:30-7pm, casual ladder tournaments starting 8. If you want to run a mini tourney ping here and well add to the bracket.

leo: Ill run a 1v1 Smash ladder if enough people show.

ida: Also can teach quick retro emulation tips for people who want to add local ROMs to the cabinet (bring USB).

rachel: Whos in for a 10-minute speedrun showcase between rounds? :video_game:

sam: Love that. See you Saturday. Bring tissues for controller sweat. :sweat_smile:
